The Technical Stuff

Evidence register, original citations, review history and rare-species reference notes. This is a scientific-workflow preview, not validated prescribing or diagnostic advice.

How to interpret this archive: Most results are candidate topics, not accepted statements. PU-EC levels 1–4 are a local reviewer proposal, not official GRADE certainty; automatic levels never constitute scientific approval. The previously approved six claims are displayed separately.

Previous clinical approvals

These six statements were approved by the project clinician in the earlier review. Their original study-type labels are preserved; they have not been retrospectively assigned an invented numeric certainty grade.

Evidence change log

Every reviewed change is kept as an append-only event. Candidate generation and article collection are not approvals.

Evidence methods

Candidate topics are extracted from species-name and topic-term co-occurrence. They are screened for potential contamination, non-human contexts, negative attribution, and case reports; even clear-looking matches require primary-source appraisal and reviewer judgement.

PU-ECInterpretation following review
1Strong body of appropriately appraised direct evidence
2Moderate body of evidence with some limitations
3Limited evidence, e.g. small clinical studies or constrained mechanism data
4Preliminary: case reports, indirect models, or uncorroborated observations

Grades must be assigned against the exact claim, not automatically from publication type. Experimental virulence findings must not be transformed into claims of human clinical causality.

See the local evidence_engine_output folder for the complete CSV register, full citation index, decisions template and append-only review audit.
